title: Trying too be too smart, the iron part was a let down
text: Trying too be too smart, the iron part was a let down. I am the queen of irons... And this one was a little ambitious and didn't succeed too well on either.  So the steamer is nice and light even when filled with water, but the steaming is limited to a very small area and only worked well on light material and wool.  Kinda exhausting trying to steam out creases in cotton and linen.  It was not that effective, and I had to refil twice to get one light knit creases.  The attached and detachment to the iron plate was a simple click of a switch, but it was awful, it was heavy and really no good.  Remember the small area where the steam comes out.. Well that is the same area that creates the heat and steam for the whole iron base!!!  Crikey, I was exhausted and had to keep ironing over and over again to get a 70% result.  Remember I had to refil for steaming, well the small water holder will keep you running to the tap for a fill up.  Ooh yeah, not that I needed another plastic water cup, this iron does not come with one.  So beware if you plan to make this your main iron.  Didn't love it.  I wanted to as I love the dual use, but this iron needs going back to the design stage.

product_metadata.title: Sunbeam GCSBRS-146 Steam and Press 2-in-1 Handheld Steamer
features: Powerful Handheld Steamer Converts to a Full-Size Iron in Seconds
description: Sunbeam Steam and Press 2-in-1 Handheld Steamer
Powerful handheld steamer offers continuous steam for smoothing away wrinkles quickly and effortlessly.
View larger

Transform the tiring chore of ironing into a simple trouble-free task with help from this GCSBRS-146-PKG Steam and Press handheld steamer/iron from Sunbeam. The innovative unit features a remarkable two-in-one design that allows it to transition seamlessly from a handheld vertical steamer to a full-size steam iron in one smooth move.
Steamer quickly attaches to soleplate--simply press and click.
View larger
Full-size iron with stainless-steel soleplate provides professional pressing and creasing.
View larger
2-in-1 Handheld Steamer

To use the iron for vertical steaming applications, give the release latch at the back of the base a simple twist. The steamer detaches from the stainless-steel soleplate for holding upright and directing steam outward versus downward.

The handheld steamer's continuous pump generates powerful non-stop steam that make wrinkles vanish. Use the steamer to quickly remove unsightly wrinkles from draperies, upholstery, or hanging garments like slacks, work shirts, and summer dresses. Best of all, it's lightweight, so extended use won't cause discomfort or fatigue.
Quickly Converts to a Full-Size Iron
Turn the steamer back into an iron by reconnecting it to the soleplate--simply position, press, and click.

As a full-sized steam iron, the unit features a durable stainless-steel soleplate for an extra-smooth glide over a variety of fabrics. Use the iron on an ironing board or other protected flat surface for traditional ironing of button-down shirts, trousers, table linen, and more. It also works well for creating smart creases in suit pants for a professionally tailored look at the office. Even more, the soleplate's pointed tip makes easy work of getting into pleats, between buttons, and along seams, while its V-shaped series of steam holes (with smaller-size holes clustered in the shape of a triangle at the tip) generate steam necessary for smoothing out the most persistent of wrinkles.
User-Friendly Controls

Turn the temperature-control dial, located under the handle on the base of the iron, to select from one of five fabric-specific heat settings. Options include synthetic, silk, wool, cotton, and linen (the hottest setting). The steam iron's easy-access thumb-tip controls include more/less steam-control buttons for adjusting the amount of steam output and a Shot of Steam button for an additional blast of steam when dealing with extra-stubborn wrinkles.
Comfortable, Convenient Design

Additional highlights include the unit's gently curved handle for a secure grip, a 360-degree tangle-free swivel cord for hassle-free maneuverability, a large see-through water reservoir with a max-fill line, and a generously sized covered water hole for easy filling. Even more, the steamer/iron provides a 1600-watt heating element for fast heat-up times, an electrical pump that ensures continuous steam, a "power" indicator light, and an anti-drip system that prevents water spotting even at low temperatures. A plastic stay-cool trivet comes included for safely storing the hot iron when finished.
3-way Motion Smart automatic shut-off turns the iron off after 15 minutes in upright position or after 30 seconds if down or on its side.
View larger
3-Way Motion Smart Auto-Off

For safety and peace of mind, the iron shuts off automatically if left unused in one of three positions. The iron will shut off on its own after 30 seconds of inactivity if left on its soleplate or if accidentally tipped over on its side; if left vertically on its heel rest, it will shut off after 15 minutes of inactivity. A useful feature, especially for those in a hurry--no need to panic in wonder after leaving the house.

The real question is this: why take up space with two garment-care devices, when you only need one? Sunbeam's Steam and Press handheld steamer/iron combo measures approximately 13-2/5 inches long by 6-2/7 inches wide by 7-1/2 inches high and carries a one-year limited warranty.
What's in the Box
Sunbeam GCSBRS-146-PKG Steam and Press handheld steamer/iron, stay-cool trivet, user manual
